narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -16.11 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.0008080-0.0008155 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.0008239; the first objective pays 0.42R at 0.0008027.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.0008080-0.0008155
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.0008239 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
